subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should Himalaya remain in OpenClaw’s bundled starter set, or should the active starter-set refactor remove it and leave future documentation maintenance to a ClawHub or owner-hosted skill?
rationale: The narrow errors are real, but the correct repository and documentation scope depends on an active maintainer-owned decision to remove this skill from core; automation cannot safely choose between investing in retained bundled docs and avoiding obsolete core churn.

options.title: Resolve removal first
options.body: Recommended: finish the starter-set decision, then either close this issue after external handoff or sponsor a version-current retained-skill repair if Himalaya stays bundled.

options.title: Retain and repair now
options.body: Explicitly keep Himalaya bundled and replace the stale skill documentation with guidance verified against the supported stable CLI version.

options.title: Externalize without waiting
options.body: Move Himalaya maintenance to a contributor-owned ClawHub skill now and document the install path instead of repairing the root bundled copy.

recommendation.title: Resolve removal first
recommendation.body: Recommended: finish the starter-set decision, then either close this issue after external handoff or sponsor a version-current retained-skill repair if Himalaya stays bundled.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent evidence trail around the starter-set and ClawHub ownership decision that controls this issue’s destination.
